Prepare Alpine Linux for Raspberry Pi boot.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Priority     | `100000`     |
| Dependencies | `rugix-ctrl` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Installs the Raspberry Pi kernel, copies boot files into the layer's boot tree,
and applies the supplied Raspberry Pi configuration. Use it with a compatible
Raspberry Pi image target.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rpi-alpine-setup"]
```
